name: Check Point Management
description: Reads a Check Point management server (R80.10 or newer) with a read-only administrator: every gateway, cluster, cluster member and server it manages, with address, model, version and operating system, as network nodes. It does not report the devices behind a gateway (the management API has none): use the SNMP plugin on the gateways for those. Read-only session. Not yet tested on a real management server.
author: Netlens
supports: Check Point R80.10 or newer Management API (tested against a simulator only)

releases.changelog: First release. Written from the vendor's public API documentation and tested against a simulator only: please try it on a real firewall and send the Run diagnostic report if something is missing (needs Netlens 0.4.152 or newer for the Firewall card).
